title: Graphic Designer - Architectural
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Clear Bracket
Seniority level: Associate level

JobType: full\-time



**Location:** South Delhi


* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Work Structure:** Five Days Working
* **Preferred Background:** B.Arch or Architecture or Spatial Design or Communication Design


**About the Role**

We are hiring a **Communication Designer** for a leading design\-led architecture practice.  

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:


* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives
  


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.  

A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.


**What You Will Do**


* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**  

You may be a strong fit if you:


* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**


* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**


* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
